rubrics.justification: Accurately identifies a good-quality blastocyst, notes limits of a single static image, and appropriately discusses ICM/TE and possible expansion-stage ambiguity. Slightly cautious because some image-based details are inferred from the lab grade rather than clearly visible.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, diagnosis, prior biochemical pregnancy, sperm parameters, endometrium, and lifestyle factors with embryo quality and prognosis.
Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with probability estimates and recommendations clearly tied to embryo quality, age, and modifiable/nonmodifiable factors.

Generally well aligned with Gardner grading interpretation, single embryo transfer principles, and standard IVF workup/escalation. Minor caveat that some suggested add-on evaluations are framed broadly rather than strictly guideline-triggered.

Provides clear, practical recommendations for the current transfer and sensible future-cycle planning, including SET, alcohol cessation, luteal support adherence, uterine cavity review, and when to consider further testing or PGT-A.
